data.name: Terran Dawn
data.detailed_description:
Command a fleet on a frontier where five species are fighting over the same
ruins. Terran Dawn is an isometric space RTS: you mine asteroids, raise a
station from a single command core, research your way up a tech tree, design the
ships you fly, and take the fight to enemies doing exactly the same thing.

Five factions, five campaigns

84 missions across five campaigns, each following a different species — and each
playing differently.
  • Terran Federation — industrial, versatile, built around layered defence
    and point-defence interception.
  • Zythian — biological hulls and weapons that keep killing after the shot
    lands.
  • Mechanoid — machine assemblies, automated production and drone swarms.
  • Xenos — scavengers who salvage wrecks and reverse-engineer whatever they
    find into their own technology.
  • Voidborn — hardened shields and void weapons that strip protection off
    anything they touch.
Missions branch. Your choices change which map you see next, and briefings arrive
as transmissions from the officers who have to live with those decisions.

Build the war machine

Start with a command core and a handful of miners. Dock modules onto your
headquarters, plant forward bases across the map, feed refineries with ore and
salvage, and push a research tree that unlocks new hulls, weapons and abilities.
Everything you field has to be paid for first.

Design your own ships

Hulls are frames with slots. Fit weapons, shields, armour, reactors, utility and
hangar modules by slot size, from fighters to dreadnoughts and capital-class
super-capitals. Heavier ships hit harder and turn worse — mass is a real cost.

A frontier that fights back

Damaging nebulae, drifting ion storms, stealth minefields, shattered planets and
paired jump gates that move fleets across the map in a single move. Terrain is
not decoration.

Survival

Hold a position against escalating waves. Every run offers mutators and upgrades
that stack into a different build, with score multipliers that reward taking the
harder path.

Skirmish and multiplayer

Fight the AI on procedurally generated or handcrafted maps at the difficulty you
choose, or take it online. Team play with shared vision, in-game chat, map pings,
and reconnection if your connection drops mid-match.

Also included

  • Named save slots, achievements, and a full in-game encyclopedia.
  • Interface and text in English, German, Spanish, French and Hungarian.

data.short_description: An isometric sci-fi RTS of fleet command and orbital industry. Mine asteroids, grow a station from a single command core, research new technology and design your own ships module by module, then wage war across 84 branching missions, survival runs and online battles.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Hungarian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 1909 or later)
  • Processor: Quad-core, Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-8350 or better
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Direct3D 12 feature level 12_0 GPU with 2 GB VRAM (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960, AMD Radeon R9 380, Intel HD Graphics 530)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. The game requires a GPU that supports Direct3D 12 feature level 12_0 and will not start on DirectX 11-only hardware. A broadband connection is required for multiplayer only; campaign, skirmish and survival are fully playable offline.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: 6-core, Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT with 6 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: An SSD is recommended. The simulation is parallelised across CPU cores, so large maps with several AI opponents benefit from 6 or more cores.
